verdict.rationale: Apple's first-party docs describe Universal Clipboard directly. You can copy images, video, or text on an iPhone or iPad and paste on a nearby Mac, or the reverse (macos-docs-5). Copy and paste between devices is also listed in the Mac help guide (macos-docs-21), and whole files can be copied and pasted between two Macs (macos-docs-40). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-device clipboard reliability.
